description: Public sample files the viewer render cases in web/e2e/viewers.spec.ts open. Each one is downloaded at seed time, checked against its size and SHA-256, and uploaded to one distributable asset; no sample is committed. Each licence was read from the source before the sample was listed. 'derivedFrom' samples are transformed from another sample.
